data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old High German words hof ‘courtyard’ and arth ‘strong, powerful’. This name was given to warriors in medieval Europe. It symbolizes bravery and courage. The name Hoffarth carries the meaning “Fighter, Brave Heart” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hoffarth usually hope their child will grow to embody fighter, brave heart and live with faith, good character and purpose.
